text: Exod.13. 16. , Gr [illegible Greek] perhaps, for [illegible Greek], as a nurse beareth or feedeth her childe, Deut.1. 31. 2.macc 7. 27, according to the Sept. and so Chrysost.
Esai.55.3. , Gre. [illegible Greek], holy or iust things, which word the Sept. both in the place of Esai 55.3. and in many others, vse for that which is in the Hebrew, Mercies.
Or, after he had in his owne age serued the will of God. , 1.Kings 2.10.
Or, in the weeke betweene, or in the Sabbath betweene.
